default.label: Default / Brand
default.meaning: Normal ThinkControl brand state; no special runtime meaning.

active.label: Active
active.meaning: A controlled feature or service is actively engaged and healthy.

warning.label: Warning
warning.meaning: Attention recommended; degraded or limited state, not a hard failure.

off.label: Off / Inactive
off.meaning: Feature disabled, inactive, unavailable, or intentionally idle.
